dct_description_sm: Land Use Designations as shown on Schedule 3ABCD, CN-1, CW-1, RC-1, KP-1 of the City of Kingston Official Plan. Land use designations regulate the character and intended function of each area, as well as the types of uses that are permitted. This information is maintained by Planning Services.
